notes: How this part was researched: the session's web-search allowance (shared, 200) ran out after seventeen searches, so the five legislative candidates, the five commissioners and four other county candidates were searched for and the sixteen city, school and court candidates were not. Campaign websites are the ones filed with the Secretary of State (read from a scratch copy of the database on which python -m ballot.local_sites files had been run; only race, name and the website cell were looked at), each opened with the kit's honest User-Agent, robots.txt read first and obeyed. Sitting officials were looked for on their own county's, city's and school district's site, and the two DFL candidates on the Minnesota DFL's list of endorsed candidates.

Left blank on purpose: Carrie A. Doom's filed site (judgecarriedoom.com) shows only "Launching Soon" and names neither her nor the office, so it is not recorded; mncourts.gov asks scripts to stay out (robots.txt), so there is no court page for either judge; co.jackson.mn.us likewise. No Republican unit's own endorsement page was found for Gruenhagen, Franson or Wedum (no searches were left to find the units' sites). Brian Walker's own site says he "ran in 2022" as a Republican; no official result page for that run was found, so no past_party is recorded. Not on their body's current member page, so no official page: Blomgren and Lindquist (Farmington), Johnson Quinton (North Mankato), McManimon (Owatonna), Novotny (Fridley), Hammerseng (Robbinsdale), Koestler (Rochester), Witt (Prior Lake-Savage), Haroldson (Stillwater, listed there only as a candidate), Loisel (Rock Ridge). Kevin Dather is not a sitting Goodhue County commissioner. No birth year was found for anyone. A second pass with searching would be worth it for the candidates with nothing below.

For the verifier: sherburnecountyauditor.com answered the kit's reader 429 each time and was read once through the page-reading tool. Isanti County writes LaRowe's term as "2023 to 2027" although the seat is on the 2026 ballot. Several county pages print commissioners' home addresses and phone numbers beside the facts recorded here; none of that was kept.

Verifier, 2026-10-02: all 27 addresses were opened again with the kit's honest User-Agent and every one answered. Each of the 15 websites is on the candidate's own line in the Secretary of State's filing files John saved (host and family name on the same line; nothing else on the line was read). Each of the 37 findings was confirmed on its page; four were reworded; none was removed. Paul Cumings's school board seat is tied to him by his own campaign site ("local school board member", committee in South St. Paul). Brian Walker's quote is nine words and on his own home page.
